what: S31: why are H.264 P-frames expensive at high quality on a static scene?
board: OpenMV N6 on nereus002, firmware OpenMV v5.0.0-57.g9d67f849f2 (PR #3247 build)
conclusion: Case C proves inter-frame prediction and the driving code are correct: a byte-identical frame costs 43 B, 0.014% of an I-frame. Case B rules out AE/AWB drift -- locking exposure and white balance changes nothing (257,756 vs 257,704). The entire P-frame cost is therefore per-frame SENSOR NOISE, which is uncorrelated between frames and which a fine QP faithfully preserves.
